interactive_p50_ms.note: The worst of several runs rather than the best. This machine is not quiet - Docker and the rest of a working laptop are on it - and a baseline taken from its quietest minute would go red on its ordinary one.

interactive_p95_ms.note: Observed between 6 and 16 ms across runs of unchanged code, which is the spread this hardware has. Band and floor together put the line at about 26 ms: past that is a change, below it is the machine. The read target of engineering-guidelines.md §4 is 200 ms, and what is guarded here is movement rather than the target.

requests_per_second.note: The offered rate, which the installation keeps up with exactly. Worth guarding tightly: a run that delivered less than it was offered stopped keeping up, and no latency percentile states that as plainly.
